Clinical trial title: ‘Efficacy and safety of autologous FMT in preventing acute GVHD’
Specific intervention: Autologous FMT in patients undergoing allo-HCT

Clinical trial title: ‘FMT in patients with acute gastrointestinal graft-versus-host-disease after allogeneic stem cell transplantation’
Specific intervention: FMT in patients with steroid-refractory gastrointestinal GVHD
FMT vs no treatment after allo-HCT
Primary outcome: GVHD incidence and relapse-free survival 1 year after allo-HCT

Clinical trial title: ‘Autologous FMT (Auto-FMT) for prophylaxis of Clostridium difficile infection in recipients of allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation’
Specific intervention: Auto-FMT vs no treatment after allo-HCT

Clinical trial title: ‘FMT and dietary fibre supplementation for the treatment of gut GVHD’
Specific intervention: FMT via oral or enteral administration with or without fibre supplementation

Clinical trial title: ‘Dietary manipulation of the microbiome-metabolomic axis for mitigating GVHD in patients undergoing allo-HCT’
Specific intervention: Starch vs placebo in patients undergoing allo-HCT

Clinical trial title: ‘High dose vitamin A in preventing gastrointestinal GVHD in participants undergoing donor stem cell transplant’
Specific intervention: Vitamin A vs no treatment in patients undergoing allo-HCT
Primary outcome: Adequate vitamin A serum levels without dose-limiting toxicity

Clinical trial title: ‘Impact of resistance exercise and nutritional endorsement on GVHD symptoms (IRENE-G)’
Specific intervention: Supervised resistance training plus nutritional endorsement vs nutritional endorsement only in patients with steroid-treated GVHD
Primary outcome: Change in physical performance from baseline to week 24

Specific intervention: GOS vs placebo in patients undergoing allo-HCT
Primary outcome: Maximal tolerated dose of GOS, incidence of grade I–IV GVHD

Clinical trial title: ‘Oral supplementation of 2′-fucosyllactose (2FL) in allogeneic bone marrow transplant recipients’
Specific intervention: 2FL vs placebo in paediatric patients undergoing allo-HCT
Primary outcome: Bloodstream infections, number of patients able to take 2FL, change in faecal levels of butyrate, acetate and propionate
